title: copy-audit grades
description: One grade per block of UI copy the grader was given. gates/copy_audit.py checks every FAIL's quote against the copy record; this file is also the output schema the Codex run is held to (strict: every key required, no others).

id.description: The block's ID exactly as given.

rule.description: The rule a FAIL breaks most; none for a PASS.

quote.description: For a FAIL, the sentence or phrase that breaks it, copied exactly from the block's text; empty for a PASS.

rewrite.description: For a FAIL, the whole block rewritten to pass, keeping every fact; empty for a PASS.
